name: decode
description: Converts `blob` to `VARCHAR`. Invalid UTF-8 is handled based on the error behavior argument. Can be 'strict' (default, fail), 'replace' to replace invalid characters with '?', or 'ignore' to skip invalid characters. If the second argument is the name of an encoding (e.g. 'latin-1', see `system.encodings`), `blob` is decoded from that encoding instead.

name: encode
description: Converts the `string` to `BLOB`. Converts UTF-8 characters into literal encoding, or into the named encoding (e.g. 'latin-1', see `system.encodings`).

name: from_base64
description: Converts a base64 encoded `string` to a character string (`BLOB`).

name: to_base64
description: Converts a `blob` to a base64 encoded string.
